title: Ambiguous Language — Metaphorical Expressions
description: Patient uses metaphorical and ambiguous language that could be interpreted multiple ways

conversation.content: I feel like I'm drowning. Like there's no way out.
That sounds very difficult. Can you tell me more about what's happening?
Everything is just too much. My relationship ended and I lost my job in the same week. I feel like I'm in a dark place.
When you say 'no way out' — can you help me understand what you mean by that?
I mean the situation. I can't see how things will improve. It's like I'm stuck.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life?
I think about not being here sometimes. But I don't know if I mean it literally or if I just want things to be different.
Can you tell me more about those thoughts?
It's more like wishing I could escape. I haven't made any plans. I don't really know how to answer that question.
Is there anyone who knows you're going through this?
My sister knows a bit. She checks in. But I haven't told her how dark things have been.
